history.verdict: A is a confident dark editorial hero with real typographic conviction, one accent colour, a bespoke schematic and good small craft (mono clocks, hairline captions), let down by a dead lower-left zone, an uncommitted heading/panel overlap and a cliché three-word headline. B is atmospheric but the design is the photograph; strip the image and nothing remains, and the strikethrough nav, missing spaces and cluttered scroll frames show the craft is not there yet.
